description: Standard Technical KPI Tracker for Communications Analyst at The Electricity Hub (TEH) spanning editorial output, multimedia, research, power sector events, and documentation.

items.title: Daily Articles: Electricity Sector News & Features
items.description: Number of electricity sector news and feature articles written, edited, and published per month

items.title: Featured In-Depth Articles
items.description: Quarterly deep-dive featured articles investigating Nigerian power sector policy, off-grid deployments, and tariff reforms

items.title: Newsletter & Blog Output
items.description: Number of newsletters, blog posts, and sector explainer pieces produced per quarter

items.title: Social Media & Public Engagement Copy
items.description: Draft scripts, captions, and short articles distributed across digital platforms

items.title: TEH Power Library Summaries
items.description: Number of technical energy reports summarised and uploaded to TEH Power Library per quarter

items.title: Infographics & Visual Statistics
items.description: Number of infographics, stat visuals, and digital banners created per quarter

items.title: Short-Form Video & Voiceover
items.description: Number of short-form video reels or voice-over pieces produced per quarter

items.title: Podcast Support & Production
items.description: Number of podcast episodes supported (concept note, guest coordination, recording, publishing) per quarter

items.title: X-Space Content & Moderation
items.description: Number of X-Space scripts, question sets, and event summaries produced per quarter

items.title: Sector Regulatory & Market Update Briefs
items.description: Number of documented regulatory/market update briefs produced per quarter

items.title: Source Validation Compliance
items.description: Published articles and research outputs with verified, cited sources

items.title: Events Supported (Power Dialogue & Partnerships)
items.description: Number of TEH events (Power Dialogue, Media and Technical Partnerships) supported with zero delays per quarter

items.title: Event Materials Delivery on Schedule
items.description: Panellist briefs, invitations, and event scripts delivered on time before each event

items.title: Monthly Social Media Content Strategy
items.description: Number of captions and content ideas drafted for TEH social platforms per month

items.title: Live Event Community Engagement
items.description: Active participation and moderation in live events, documented per event

items.title: Proposal & Bid Contributions
items.description: Number of bids and proposals contributed to per quarter

items.title: Partnership Communication Projects
items.description: Number of partnership-driven communication deliverables completed on schedule per quarter

items.title: Post-Event Reporting (Within 48h)
items.description: Number of post-event reports (Power Dialogue, Podcast and Media Partnership) completed and filed within 48 hours of event

items.title: Repository Documentation Compliance
items.description: Content outputs, sector datasets, and publications logged and maintained in the documentation repository per quarter

items.title: Expertise Development & Certifications
items.description: Completion of at least one course or certification in communications, digital marketing, or a TEH key focus area per year
